title: 2566. Maximum Difference by Remapping a Digit

examples.explanation: To achieve the maximum value, Bob can remap the digit 1 to the digit 9 to yield 99899. To achieve the minimum value, Bob can remap the digit 1 to the digit 0, yielding 890. The difference between these two numbers is 99009.
The maximum value that can be returned by the function is 99 (if 0 is replaced by 9) and the minimum value that can be returned by the function is 0 (if 9 is replaced by 0). Thus, we return 99.
